title: Plan predictions are scored by command (S3)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S3 (Sector 2 — Proof (ADR 0021; north-star item 5)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0021 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: `Predicted: metric <name> <op> N` is parsed by `krn ledger --predictions` from `spec/metrics.json`; fable-plan-brief.md documents it; every ADR measurement is registered
Files: see ADR 0021 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn ledger --predictions --share`: the printed share is above 0 once plan.md rows score
Predicted: metric plan-slices-scored-share >= 0.8
